scientific_integrity: All infinite-family statements proved using the cited linearity theorem and explicit finite group and linear-algebra arguments. The finite checker is corroboration rather than a substitute for proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies irreducible closed totally invariant varieties under the first inverse image for power-linear maps over the complex numbers only; it does not classify reducible exceptional sets or higher-iterate totally periodic sets. The linearity theorem is taken from Luo--Meng (arXiv:2610.10103v1). Chang--Luo (arXiv:2607.27738v1) already establishes the sharp general binomial cardinality bounds. The Chang--Luo full manuscript was not accessible for full-text comparison; novelty remains subject to this literature risk.
title: The distributive lattice of totally invariant varieties for power-linear projective maps
